versions.changelog:
image-fetch-toolkit 1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive toolkit for searching and fetching images from online sources.
- Supports integration with common free stock photo APIs (Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Flickr).
- Includes search engine image API instructions (Google, Bing) and Tavily web extraction.
- Provides references for sourcing academic and scientific images (Semantic Scholar, arXiv, PubMed Central, and more).
- Offers guides and code for multi-panel academic figure composition with labeled panels.
